title: Google Opal Builds AI Apps From Plain English, Free
description:
Comment "AI" and I'll send you the link 📩

Google just released Opal — a free no-code platform that builds fully functioning AI apps from plain English.

Think n8n + Lovable in one 👇
1️⃣ Describe your idea ("build me an AI ad generator")
2️⃣ It builds the whole automation AND a clean interactive front-end
3️⃣ Your app asks users the right questions, then generates the result (even video with Veo 3)
4️⃣ Edit workflows and share with one click

👉 Follow me and comment "AI" and I'll DM you the link

#googleai #opal #nocode #aiautomation #AItools
